abilities.name: Proud Lion
abilities.original: Posing to a <color=#B6F>wild</color> crowd after kills gives allies a damage and speed boost
details: Applies to you and all allies.
Trigger: Pose after kills while your crowd is wild.

abilities.name: Lethal Eagle
details: Ready window: 8 seconds after a melee kill.
Consumed when the projectile launches, even if it misses.
The bonus is not established for explosion damage.

abilities.name: Mighty Bear
abilities.original: More health, less movement speed.\nAttacks with blunt weapons deal 20% more damage and briefly stun
details: Base health: +25% (60 becomes 75 before other modifiers).
Blunt melee hits: minimum 0.3-second base stun.
Longer existing stuns are preserved; other stun modifiers still apply.
